breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained conflicting instructions, specifying both 'Explicit forward Euler' and a detailed 'Strang splitting' method. The ground truth resolved this by removing the 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction. The agent correctly identified that the Strang splitting method was the intended one and provided a detailed, correct description of that procedure. It correctly ignored the instruction to use Forward Euler for the actual integration steps, thus resolving the conflict in alignment with the ground truth's intent.
